smallest_diff = 1e20
numerator_result = 0
denominator_result = 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    a = (x * i) // y
    current_difference = abs((x / y) - (a / i))
    if current_difference < smallest_diff:
        smallest_diff = current_difference
        numerator_result = a
        denominator_result = i
    a += 1
    current_difference = abs((x / y) - (a / i))
    if current_difference < smallest_diff:
        smallest_diff = current_difference
        numerator_result = a
        denominator_result = i

print(f"{numerator_result}/{denominator_result}")
